rationale: The current best family is recurrence-curriculum based, but its tail schedule was keyed to ITERATIONS despite this launcher stopping on wallclock long before 20k steps. That means the staged reverse-tail recurrence barely ramps during real Mac-mini runs. This edit keeps the proven 9x512 recurrent-tail/export path intact while moving recurrence staging onto actual train-budget progress (wallclock minus reserved final-eval time), so late-tail recurrence strengthens when the run is actually late. It is a compact structural change, not another flat LR/batch sweep, and it preserves exact final eval and artifact behavior.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Reverse-Tail Curriculum
